newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea had talks with trade unions leaders about the stage of negotiations on a reform package with international financial institutions.
The government will discuss the reform package, including social protection measures, with labour unions after the package has been completed.

* Agriculture Minister Dinu Gavrilescu said that Romania's farming policy will be based on three key elements -- the prices of agricultural products will be liberalised, import taxes will be reviewed and credit policies will be improved.

* Parliament reconvenes from its winter recess this afternoon. Changes to the foreign investments law and adoption of the state budget for 1997 will be among priorities for the new parliament session.
